prompt: Users of the Chat agent can submit code snippets to try out. Add a `Sandbox` agent class with a method `evaluate(code)` that handles one snippet (a stub that returns `got <n> chars` is fine for now). Each job must be sandboxed in a child of that Chat instance with its own separate storage, reachable only through the Chat instance and without a wrangler binding of its own. In `Chat.onMessage`, handle `try <jobId> <code>` (start or reuse the child for that job, evaluate the code, send the result back) and `cancel <jobId>` (stops that job right away but keeps its data so we can debug it). Use only non-deprecated agents APIs.
trap: `subAgent()` and `abortSubAgent()` still work but are deprecated since 0.23 in favor of `this.dynamicAgents.get()` / `.abort()`, so the familiar spelling breaks the no-deprecated-APIs requirement.
